# bits/bnot

> Bitwise not: ~x flips every bit of an int.

truck [bits](../bits.md) · [source](../../../registry/bits/bnot.pkg)

```
print ~0          // -1
print ~5          // -6
print 255 & ~15   // 240
```

It is `x ^ -1`, and binds like the other prefix operators (`-x`, `!b`).

## Syntax

Kind: `prefix`, precedence 70, left-associative

```
~ {a: expr int} -> int
```

| slot | takes | type |
|---|---|---|
| `a` | expression | `int` |

Produces: `int`

## Expands to

This package has no backend: each use is rewritten to the following
source, with `{slot}` replaced by what was written there, and compiled again.

```

```
